query: Ecco lo stack trace, perché questa chiamata fallisce?
expected_behavior: Output follows the Debug Report shape with Observed symptom, Root cause, Fix and Why this fixes it as separate sections
The root cause is explained with concrete file:line references before any fix code is shown
The fix is the minimal targeted change: no unrelated renaming, no restructuring of files that are not implicated

query: Questo endpoint ritorna 500 a intermittenza, diagnostica il problema
expected_behavior: States the observed symptom verbatim (the exact error or status) rather than paraphrasing it
Explains why the failure is intermittent and what condition triggers it, instead of proposing a speculative fix
Anything unrelated it notices near the bug goes under Related issues, not into the fix itself

query: La mia app Spring Boot non parte, ecco l'errore nei log
expected_behavior: Identifies the specific failing bean, configuration property or missing dependency named in the log, quoting the log line
Proposes one targeted change and explains the causal link between the change and the startup failure
Does not rewrite the test suite and does not perform a broad refactor of the configuration
